control.title: Post-incident review
control.description: Run a post-incident review for significant incidents and track improvement actions.

evidence_hint: Post-incident review documents and action tracking.
acceptance_criteria: Actions from reviews are tracked to completion

criteria_coverage.criterion: Actions from reviews are tracked to completion

requirements.title: Communicating deficiencies
requirements.guidance: Report control deficiencies to those responsible for corrective action in time.

requirements.title: Report security incidents and card data breaches to RBI
requirements.guidance: Report security incidents and card data breaches to RBI in the stipulated time, plus monthly cyber incident reports with root cause and preventive actions.

requirements.guidance: Recover from incidents and apply lessons learned.

requirements.title: Learning from information security incidents
requirements.guidance: Use lessons from incidents to strengthen controls.
